//: `types: []` is empty on purpose. Left unset, TypeScript ambiently loads every
`@types/*` package it finds while walking up to the workspace root, which silently
grants `process`, `Buffer`, and the rest of the Node surface to packages that must
stay platform-neutral (Document 14 §2). It also made `tsc -p tsconfig.typecheck.json`
not), so one gate passed while the other failed on identical code. A package that
genuinely needs ambient types declares them in its own tsconfig.
